setup-emotion.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
key=os.environ['MINIMAX_API_KEY']
OUT="xiaosuda/jobs/1014-how-are-you-v3/tts_v4"
CHICK=("chunzhen_xuedi",1); SUDA=("Cute_Elf",0)
def tts(text, voice, speed, out, pitch=0, emotion=None):
    body={"model":"speech-02-hd","text":text,"stream":False,
          "voice_setting":{"voice_id":voice,"speed":speed,"vol":1.0,"pitch":pitch},
          "audio_setting":{"sample_rate":32000,"bitrate":128000,"format":"mp3","channel":1},
          "output_format":"hex"}
    if emotion: body["emotion"]=emotion
    req=Request("https://api.minimaxi.com/v1/t2a_v2",data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
                headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+key,"Content-Type":"application/json"})
    r=json.load(urlopen(req,timeout=60))
    assert r["base_resp"]["status_code"]==0, r["base_resp"]
    p=os.path.join(OUT,out+".mp3")
    Path(p).write_bytes(bytes.fromhex(r["data"]["audio"]))
    pt=p+".t.mp3"
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-y","-loglevel","error","-i",p,"-af",
        "silenceremove=start_periods=1:start_threshold=-45dB:start_silence=0.05,areverse,silenceremove=start_periods=1:start_threshold=-45dB:start_silence=0.05,areverse",
        "-codec:a","libmp3lame","-b:a","128k",pt],check=True)
    os.replace(pt,p)
    d=subprocess.run(["ffprobe","-v","error","-show_entries","format=duration","-of","default=nw=1:nk=1",p],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
    return float(d)
jobs=[
 ("e1_01","How are you?",CHICK,1.0,"happy"),
 ("e1_02","I'm fine, thank you. And you?",SUDA,1.0,"happy"),
 ("e1_03","Hmm, it's correct,",CHICK,0.9,"neutral"),
 ("e1_04","but it sounds a little textbook.",CHICK,0.85,"neutral"),
]
for f,text,(v,p),s,emo in jobs:
    print(f"{f} [{emo}] {tts(text,v,s,f,p,emo):5.2f}s  {text}")
EOF

quiz-question.command:
mkdir -p xiaosuda/jobs/1015-v8-quiz-slideup && cd xiaosuda/jobs/1015-v8-quiz-slideup && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, subprocess
KEY = os.environ["MINIMAX_API_KEY"]
payload = {
    "model": "speech-02-hd",
    "text": "If someone says 'How are you?' to you, how do you answer?",
    "stream": False,
    "output_format": "hex",
    "voice_setting": {"voice_id": "chunzhen_xuedi", "speed": 1.0, "vol": 1.0, "pitch": 1, "emotion": "happy"},
    "audio_setting": {"sample_rate": 32000, "bitrate": 128000, "format": "mp3", "channel": 1},
}
r = subprocess.run(["curl","-s","-X","POST","https://api.minimaxi.com/v1/t2a_v2",
    "-H",f"Authorization: Bearer {KEY}","-H","Content-Type: application/json",
    "-d",json.dumps(payload)], capture_output=True, text=True)
d = json.loads(r.stdout)
assert d.get("base_resp",{}).get("status_code")==0, d.get("base_resp")
open("e1_00_quiz.mp3","wb").write(bytes.fromhex(d["data"]["audio"]))
print("ok", len(d["data"]["audio"])//2, "bytes")
EOF
ffprobe -v quiet -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 e1_00_quiz.mp3
